_meta.description: Compose batch of two crosstab slots over region x segment on experiment.pulse, total_pop (every row) and audience_a (the variant arm, by FILTER_INCLUDE), decorated with an OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_REF cell overlay: 100 * audience_a cell / total_pop cell, the share of each cell the audience holds (40 to 69 here, near 50 because the variant is about half the cohort). reference names the baseline slot by its label, targets the slots the overlay decorates. A filter leaves the crosstab's keys alone, so the two slots align. The batch first checks that the labels resolve (PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_UNKNOWN), the key sets match (PULSE_OVERLAY_KEY_SET_DIVERGENT) and the schemas match (PULSE_OVERLAY_SCHEMA_DIVERGENT). A zero reference cell emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO and reads null; a missing one emits the same code with ref_missing and the cell stays absent. Buffered.
